tei:div.tei:p: 567) brda go mgon khang gi dus mchod gtong lugs/ tshes lnga la/ rata gling thugs rje chen po gsang ba 'dus pa'am/ yang na thugs rje chen po sdug bsngal rang grol dzapra bstod yan/ gnam chos gur drag phur mjug bsam gtan cho ga/ bka' brgyad/ dgongs 'dus/ king kang*/ khro chu/ 'char ka bde mchog rta mgrin/ phyag rdor/ khyung*/ phur pa/ phag khros/ sgrol dkar/ ku ru kul+le/ 'od zer can/ lo gyon/ mtsho rgyal/ seng gdong bcas/ ma mgon lcam dral/ 'khrugs skong mnga' gsol bcas sbrel/ legs ldan/ gza'/ tshe ring*/ g.yu sgron/ dur khrod lha mo/ tsi dmar/ rgyal po/ dgongs btsan/ gser skyems bcas/ ma ning*/ tshogs bdag mdung 'dzin/ brag lha/ zhal bzhi/ phyag bzhi/ gnod sbyin/ sngags srung*/ dud sol/ zhing skyong*/ dur bdag/ ngan ne/ rta lha/ dzam la/ tshe ring gza'/ rdor legs/ spu gri/ thang lha/ spom ra/ g.yu sgron/ ngom rgyal/ klu rgyal bcas/ gsang 'dus byin 'bebs/ tshogs bskang ba'i mthar/ dam can gsol rigs/ drang lhag/ bskul chad brtan bro/ mchod bstod/ nongs bshags/ rten bzhugs/ bsdu ldang*/ bsngo smon/ bkra shis rgyal dkyil bcas so// ༈ tshes brgyad la rag gling gur drag me rlung 'khyil ba'am/ bka' brgyad dpal chen 'dus pa 568) bsnyen bstod bcas/ gur drag phur mjug nas/ seng gdong yan/ ma mgon nas gser skyems yan/ ma ning nas klu rgyal yan/ tshogs lhag ma bcas/ mgon po'i stod las cha tshang*/ de nub dam can bskul chad brtan sogs mtha' bsdu/ ༈ tshes bcu la bla ma dgongs 'dus/ rata gling thugs sgrub/ rig 'dzin 'dus pa gang rigs gtang*/ gur drag nas/ seng gdong yan/ ma mgon nas gser skyems yan/ ma ning nas klu rgyal yan/ tshogs bskang ba/ dam can drang lhag bskul chad brtan sogs mthar dbyung*/ ༈ tshes bcu bzhi la/ gur drag dang*/ dpal chen gang rung gis mgon gsol gtang*/ ༈ tshes bco lnga la rang gling tshe sgrub= rig 'dus tshe sgrub kyi bskang gso gtong lugs spyi ltar/

༈ tshes nyer bzhi/ dngos grub rol mtsho'i rjes 'brang mthar/ ma mgon nas gser skyems yan/ gter gzhi nas rol mtsho mthar dbyung*/ ༈ tshes nyer gnyis/ king kang ngam/ tshe bdag gi tshogs bskang bskang gso gtang*/ ༈ tshes nyer gsum/ dpal chen/ gur drag gang rung gi mgon gsol gtang*/ ༈ tshes nyer lnga/ yum bka' bde chen rgyal mo'i bskang gso gtang*/ ༈ tshes nyer dgu/ dpal chen gur drag gang rung gi mgon gsol/ spro na smad las gtang*/ ༈ tshes sum bcu la gnam chos bskang gsol gtang ngo*/
